ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported no share buyback activity on September 11, 2026, as part of its ongoing open market program. However, as of this date, the company has cumulatively bought back 1,188,150 equity shares, impacting its outstanding share count. A notable red flag is a clear data error in the report, where the cumulative quantity of shares bought back is incorrectly listed in the "Average Price of acquisition" column, omitting the actual average acquisition price.
